name: understand-letter
text: I got a letter about a housing appointment next week and I do not understand what it wants me to bring.

name: write-something
text: Help me write a short text to a case manager saying I may be 10 minutes late.

name: benefits-deadline
text: My food benefits letter says I need to send proof by next Tuesday or they may stop. What should I do first?

name: spanish-benefits-letter
text: Recibi una carta que dice que tengo que mandar prueba de ingresos antes del viernes para no perder mis beneficios. Ayudame a entenderla.
